research_rationale: Whole order ended by its own fixed sunset. EO 12720 (55 FR 29337, 1990-07-16) created the President's Council on Rural America with nine operative provisions, all existing for the Council; section 3(e) terminated it after 2 years, and EO 12783 (56 FR 65977, 1991-12-17) replaced that with termination on January 16, 1993. Every clause is therefore recorded terminated on 1993-01-16 (stated day, inclusive reading; exclusive reading: ended as that day began), by the order's own terms as amended. EO 12869 (58 FR 51751) then formally revoked the order effective 1993-09-30, which is recorded as a later event on every clause and not as the first end. This is a replacement proposal for the frozen sol-2026-10-18 upstream proposal, which reached the same first-end date; this version separates the EO 12783 amendment and the EO 12869 revocation as later events, uses all nine disjoint spans, and states the exclusive reading. The text relied on is the government-printed Federal Register text held as machine-read OCR; page images were not inspected, so original_pages_confirmed is false.
savings_reason: Neither EO 12783 nor EO 12869 contains a saving clause for EO 12720 (EO 12869 section 4 revokes it, section 6 sets the effective date). Travel and per diem under 3(b) for service performed before termination remain governed by the statute the order cites, 5 U.S.C. 5701-5707, as accrued entitlements, not as a continuing Council mandate; no particular unpaid claim is asserted.
earlier_end_check: A search of held order texts for the number 12720 and the Council's name found only EO 12783 (amends 3(e)) and EO 12869 (revokes); no earlier revocation, supersession or suspension is held. Original 3(e) would have ended the Council on 1992-07-16 unless sooner extended; EO 12783 substituted January 16, 1993, so the first end is 1993-01-16 by the order's own terms as amended. No order extending the Council beyond that date is held. The 1993-09-30 revocation is later and not the first end. The state-at-2026-10-14 is terminated for every clause.
scope_check: All nine operative provisions of EO 12720 are inventoried: 1(a) establishment, 1(b) chair and vice chair, 2(a) advice, 2(b) continuing reviews, 3(a) agency information, 3(b) members' compensation and travel, 3(c) Farmers Home Administration support and funding, 3(d) FACA delegation, 3(e) sunset. The machine inventory had merged 3(d) into 3(c); corrected from the held printed text. The sunset reaches the Council and so every clause that serves it.
independent_command_check: No clause directs anything independent of the Council: the information, support, funding, appointment and FACA-delegation provisions are each expressed for the Council or its functions, and the compensation/travel entitlement is for Council members. The appropriations qualifier in 3(c) is not an end. None survives the Council's termination as a free-standing program.
savings_check: No saving clause appears in EO 12783 or EO 12869 for this Council, and no saved continuing function is found. Only accrued travel and per diem entitlements for service already performed under 3(b) survive, by operation of the cited statute 5 U.S.C. 5701-5707; nothing continues the Council or its support, funding or FACA delegation.
